title: [yencoding-multi] Add no-panic tests and u64::MAX offset coverage
description: Skoll LOW-58 + LOW-64: (1) Add yencoding-multi/tests/no_panic.rs exercising adversarial inputs: begin=u64::MAX, end=u64::MAX, data.len()==0, overlapping parts with extreme offsets, many small parts. (2) Add test: part_begin=u64::MAX, part_end=u64::MAX, total_size=512 — verify OutOfRange is returned, not a panic.
close_reason: Added 11 no-panic tests exercising u64::MAX offsets, reversed ranges, zero-length data, overlapping parts, many small parts, and MAX_TOTAL_SIZE boundary.
